name: James Hoffmann

books.title: How to Make the Best Coffee at Home

why: James Hoffmann is the main reference behind this website and behind my own coffee learning overall. His channel covers everything from how-tos and gear reviews to deep dives on coffee science, and he's a former World Barista Champion and the founder of Square Mile Coffee Roasters. Well worth checking out both his YouTube channel and his two books.
why_pt: James Hoffmann é a principal referência por trás deste site e do meu aprendizado sobre café em geral. O canal dele cobre de tudo, de tutoriais e reviews de equipamento a mergulhos profundos na ciência do café, e ele é ex-Campeão Mundial de Barista e fundador da Square Mile Coffee Roasters. Vale muito a pena conferir tanto o canal no YouTube quanto os dois livros.
